records.rationale: Deliberately retain native GPL tracing_on and tracing_is_on exports rather than ACK removal. The ACK message explicitly seeks to deny vendor module control/query of global tracing; this is a real policy difference, not claimed KMI-only. Requested vendor source customization and minimal native deviation favor keeping the existing upstream interface. Trusted modules can therefore disable global tracing or observe its state, potentially reducing diagnostic visibility. These are kernel-code interfaces, not a new unprivileged access path, and removing two exports would not sandbox arbitrary loaded kernel code. Native function bodies/export types and build symbols are unchanged. Source/link metadata verification only; callbacks and module loading were not exercised.
